name: PT Teladan Prima Agro Tbk
summary: PT Teladan Prima Agro Tbk, along with its subsidiaries, is a diversified agribusiness operating in palm oil plantation management, milling, and renewable energy production. The company cultivates a substantial 60,468 hectares of oil palm across East Kalimantan Province. From these extensive estates, including both its directly owned (nucleus) and partner (plasma) plantations, it processes fresh fruit bunches to yield crude palm oil and palm kernel. Additionally, PT Teladan Prima Agro Tbk generates green electricity by converting palm oil waste, supplying this power to external consumers. Established in 2004, the company's corporate headquarters are located in South Jakarta, Indonesia.
